decisions.reason: The closing caution did not assert singleton measurability, so no probability or covariance conclusion failed. It nevertheless named undefined constructions. The Definition now specifies cells B in G, measurable inverse-image macrocells, their extended reference sizes, and an explicitly additional entropy assignment on a chosen family of cells; singleton fibres require measurable singletons. All preceding state, density, L2 and pushforward definitions remain unchanged.

The invariant-flow conclusion is valid, but step 3.2 wrote compositions outside the supplied compact band. The repaired proof fixes D=H^{-1}([a,b]), uses q supported in (a,b), integrates only over D and extends products by zero. Step 4.1 proves continuity and test-function equality only inside that band. Step 5.1 separately handles the empty closed set before using distance. The Statement and all coordinate-normalization claims are unchanged.

F4 cited a phase-reference definition for an arbitrary measure space. The original derivative and Hessian calculations are correct, but that reference did not itself define generic covariance. The Statement now explicitly defines P_theta, its integrable expectations and centered covariance; general density/integration suppliers support F4, and step 3.1 checks second-moment and mixed-moment integrability before expanding the covariance. The common-envelope differentiation proof is unchanged.

For an indistinguishable-particle quotient, finite normalization alone admits label-dependent H and therefore a noninvariant Gibbs lift, contrary to the counting supplier. The Postulate now requires H(gz)=H(z) almost everywhere for each within-species permutation, which makes the Gibbs density invariant almost everywhere; it retains the distinguishable-label convention. This makes the inherited physical model restriction explicit without changing the intended Gibbs formula or empirical qualifications.

The arbitrary measurable sector Hamiltonians did not explicitly meet the counting supplier symmetry condition for a physical quotient state. The Postulate now requires within-species permutation invariance almost everywhere in every sector. Multiplication by the sector-constant fugacity preserves that invariance; the vacuum still has mass one and H_0=0. Sector-sum convergence remains a separate assumption, and distinguishable labels retain their declared convention.

The reference nu_N already contains dV/V0, so the additional outer volume integral made the displayed normalizer ill-typed. Delta_N is now one integral over the complete (V,y,p) product domain. Added within-species symmetry makes its Gibbs lift admissible for the declared factorial/quotient convention. The dimensionless prior, V^N Jacobian, generalized pressure units and finite-positive normalization hypothesis are preserved. Concordia eq.123 was retrieved and read: it also uses one volume integral, while V0 is this item’s explicit reference convention.

A physically indistinguishable shell preparation requires a permutation-invariant Hamiltonian, not merely an arbitrary regular H. The Postulate now imposes pointwise H(gz)=H(z) for the specified cotangent permutation action in both branches. Pointwise symmetry is needed here because ambient almost-everywhere equality need not control a particular zero-volume shell. Cotangent permutations preserve phase volume and the energy graph shell measure, so the shell and band laws use the required symmetric lift; all AC, compactness, normalization and coordinate-scale hypotheses remain.

A2 incorrectly identified the full physical reference with its restriction to the allowed position support. It now identifies the reference on the whole ambient Borel phase space and assigns the support restriction to the canonical density. The Statement already used exactly that extension by +infinity; Borel symmetrization, null-set completion, Gaussian normalization and moment computations are sound and unchanged.

The Statement already imposed local common exponential-moment envelopes, and both derivative directions (-1,mu) and beta times the eta direction correctly give the displayed covariances. A1 nevertheless grouped these extra bounds with the preparation citation. It now cites the postulate only for the density and positive finite normalizer, then explicitly states the envelopes as additional theorem hypotheses. No Statement or physical-scope change is made.

The theorem inherits V in m^d and P_ext in J m^-d from its explicit isobaric-preparation supplier. Its use of def-td-si-quantities is the temperature/Boltzmann convention in A2; it does not identify this generalized d-volume with that separate macroscopic framework’s cubic-metre state coordinate. PV has energy units for every d, the beta and pressure differentiation directions are valid under the stated envelopes, and all response identities are dimensionally consistent. Item bytes are unchanged; only necessary exact supplier quotes in its owning contract are refreshed.

V is the one-particle d-dimensional position volume in the adopted dN-dimensional phase integral; it therefore has units m^d. A2 cites def-td-si-quantities specifically for T, k_B and beta, not to identify V with the separate macroscopic framework’s m^3 coordinate. The action scale makes lambda_T a length, so V/lambda_T^d is dimensionless for every d. Gaussian differentiation, the factorial sector sum, Poisson moments and canonical conditional law are sound. No item repair is required.

The claimed volume and enthalpy means were correct, but the original envelope argument mentioned only the volume tail and did not supply a joint kinetic-energy bound. Step 2.2 now gives an integrable common Gaussian-volume majorant and transfers it to the exact (B_*,V) statistics in a natural-parameter neighborhood. Step 3.1 explicitly integrates (p exp(-a p^2)) prime to obtain the kinetic mean and adds the volume mean. A2 also states generalized pressure/volume units separately. The Example and physical scope remain unchanged.
